stories.title: The Big Cat
stories.summary: A big cat looks for a place to nap.

pages.text: The cat can sit on a mat.
The cat naps in the sun.

stories.title: Sam and the Shell
stories.summary: Sam finds a shell on the beach and hears the sea.

pages.text: Sam went to the beach with his mother.
He saw a ship on the sea. Then he saw a shell in the sand.
Sam held the shell to his ear. Shhh! It was like the sea.
Sam put the shell in his bag. It was the best thing he found that day.

stories.title: The Snail and the Rain
stories.summary: A slow snail enjoys a rainy day while everyone else hides.

pages.text: It was a gray day. Dark clouds filled the sky, and then the rain began.
The goat ran into the barn. The sheep hid under a tree. The birds sat in their nest.
But the snail did not hide. The snail likes the rain. Wet leaves are the best place to go for a slow walk.
When the sun came out, the snail was far from home. It did not mind. It had seen the whole garden.

stories.title: The Storm at the Farm
stories.summary: A girl helps her grandfather get the animals safe before a storm.

pages.text: Mara was visiting her grandfather's farm when the sky turned dark and the wind started to howl.
"A storm is coming," Grandpa said. "We need to get the horses into the barn before the thunder starts."
Mara was scared of thunder, but she knew the horses were scared too. She talked to them in a calm, quiet voice as she led them inside.
When the last horse was safe, the rain poured down. Grandpa smiled. "You were very helpful," he said. Mara felt proud, and not scared at all.
